validation.portability_test_method: Restored a copied export in a fresh resolved temporary directory. Original review reads and release-directory snapshots were guarded to fail; full validation reconstructed private release copies from the export.

limitations: This is retrospective proposal review, not proof of early detection or calibrated alert quality.
Acknowledgment does not accept a new canonical fact, resolve the project, or enable delivery.
The live pilot exercises admission and acknowledgment only. Resolution, retraction, reopening and recurrence are tested on explicitly synthetic offline fixtures.
The source-text and discovery queues, monitoring configuration and publication state are unchanged.
The local export contains release derivatives and bounded evidence excerpts, not raw publisher response bodies. Its portability does not grant redistribution rights.
